visit_columns.name: is_eligible
visit_columns.sql: COALESCE(form_name = 'Waterpoint Registration' AND rf_verdict = '✅ ELIGIBLE FOR INSTALLATION', FALSE)

visit_columns.name: is_functional
visit_columns.sql: COALESCE(form_name = 'Routine Rider Visit' AND dispenser_status = 'functional', FALSE)

visit_columns.name: is_full_refill
visit_columns.sql: COALESCE(form_name = 'Routine Rider Visit' AND refill_completed = 'yes' AND COALESCE(refill_short_flag, '') <> 'short_refill', FALSE)

visit_columns.name: is_offsite
visit_columns.sql: COALESCE(form_name = 'Routine Rider Visit' AND CAST(payment_eligible AS DECIMAL) = 0, FALSE)

visit_columns.name: fcr_readable
visit_columns.sql: COALESCE(form_name = 'FCR Test' AND fcr_pass_fail IN ('pass', 'fail'), FALSE)

visit_columns.name: regular_use
visit_columns.sql: COALESCE(form_name = 'FCR Test' AND use_frequency IN ('every_time', 'most_of_the_time'), FALSE)

aggregates.name: num_records
aggregates.label: Records
aggregates.means: Every form filed for the waterpoint: registration, installation, rider visits and household chlorine tests.

aggregates.name: first_visit
aggregates.label: Registered on
aggregates.means: Date of the waterpoint's first record (its registration).

aggregates.name: last_visit
aggregates.label: Latest record
aggregates.means: Date of the waterpoint's most recent record.

aggregates.name: registrations
aggregates.label: Registrations
aggregates.means: Waterpoint Registration forms filed for the waterpoint.

aggregates.name: eligible_regs
aggregates.label: Eligible registrations
aggregates.means: Registrations the form graded ELIGIBLE FOR INSTALLATION (no red flags).

aggregates.name: installs
aggregates.label: Installations
aggregates.means: Dispenser Installation forms filed at the waterpoint.

aggregates.name: rider_visits
aggregates.label: Rider visits
aggregates.means: Routine Rider Visits filed at the waterpoint.

aggregates.name: rider_weeks
aggregates.label: Weeks with a rider visit
aggregates.means: Distinct calendar weeks with at least one Routine Rider Visit.

aggregates.name: functional_visits
aggregates.label: Visits finding it functional
aggregates.means: Rider visits recording the dispenser's overall status as functional.

aggregates.name: full_refills
aggregates.label: Full refills
aggregates.means: Rider visits that filled the dispenser to the fill line, with at least 3 kg after filling (the app's short-refill rule).

aggregates.name: offsite_visits
aggregates.label: Off-site rider visits
aggregates.means: Rider visits logged more than 30 m from the waterpoint, which the app marks not payment-eligible.

aggregates.name: fcr_tests
aggregates.label: Household chlorine tests
aggregates.means: FCR Tests filed for households collecting from the waterpoint.

aggregates.name: fcr_readable_tests
aggregates.label: Readable chlorine tests
aggregates.means: FCR Tests with a result the worker could read.

aggregates.name: fcr_passes
aggregates.label: Tests at or above 0.2 mg/L
aggregates.means: FCR Tests the app graded pass: free chlorine of at least 0.2 mg/L.

aggregates.name: fcr_unreadable_tests
aggregates.label: Unreadable chlorine tests
aggregates.means: FCR Tests where the worker recorded the result as unreadable.

aggregates.name: regular_users
aggregates.label: Households using it regularly
aggregates.means: Tested households saying they use the dispenser every time or most of the time they collect water.

properties.name: installed
properties.label: Dispenser installed
properties.means: A Dispenser Installation form has been filed at this waterpoint.

properties.name: eligible
properties.label: Eligible for a dispenser
properties.means: The waterpoint's registration graded it ELIGIBLE FOR INSTALLATION.

properties.name: active_weeks
properties.label: Weeks since installation
properties.means: Weeks from installation to the report date, not counting the installation week.
properties.sql: CASE WHEN install_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((:as_of)::timestamp - install_date::timestamp)) / 604800)::int, 0) END

indicators_doc.description: One row per waterpoint, from registration through dispenser installation, weekly rider visits and household chlorine tests. Indicators come from the Deliver app's own forms and rules.

display.title: Chlorine dispenser programme, Nigeria (synthetic)
display.targets_note: No targets are shown: the app defines pass rules (a chlorine test passes at 0.2 mg/L or more; a visit counts within 30 m) but the programme has not set targets. Registrations, waterpoint names and locations are real; all delivery activity is synthetic.

meta.label: Chlorine pass
meta.plain: Of household water tests that could be read, the share with free chlorine of at least 0.2 mg/L.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — FCR Test, last_waterpoint_fcr_pass_fail: pass = result >= 0.2 mg/L. No programme target.

meta.label: Functional
meta.plain: Of rider visits, the share that found the dispenser fully functional.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — Routine Rider Visit, dispenser_overall_status = functional. No programme target.

meta.label: Regular use
meta.plain: Of households tested, the share who use the dispenser every time or most of the time they collect water.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — FCR Test, last_dispenser_use_frequency in (every_time, most_of_the_time). No programme target.

meta.label: Full refills
meta.plain: Of rider visits, the share that refilled the dispenser to the fill line with at least 3 kg of solution.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — Routine Rider Visit, refill_completed = yes and not refill_short_flag (post-fill < 3 kg). No programme target.

meta.label: Off-site visits
meta.plain: Of rider visits, the share logged more than 30 m from the waterpoint, which the app does not count as payable.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — Routine Rider Visit, calculations/payment_eligible = 0 (distance_from_waterpoint > 30 m). No programme threshold.

meta.label: Weekly coverage
meta.plain: Of the full weeks since each dispenser was installed, the share with at least one rider visit.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — Routine Rider Visit dates against the Dispenser Installation date. No programme target.

meta.label: Eligible
meta.plain: Of registered waterpoints, the share the registration form graded eligible for a dispenser (no red flags).
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — Waterpoint Registration, save_assessment/rf_verdict. Real registration data.

meta.label: Installed
meta.plain: Of waterpoints graded eligible, the share with a dispenser installed.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — Dispenser Installation filed at an eligible waterpoint. No programme target.

meta.label: Unreadable tests
meta.plain: Of household chlorine tests, the share the worker recorded as unreadable.
meta.scope_note: Deliver app (opp 2158, Chlorine Application) — FCR Test, fcr_entry_mode = unreadable. No programme threshold.
